cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. A fair race gives me a head start. I've had a tiring morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then compensate us proportionally. Mine involved stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We start on the same line.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Move my portion of the line forward.
